description: A sixteen-step trigger sequencer whose steps can be switched by hand or by a trigger of their own

params.text: Sets the tempo of the internal clock, about 15 to about 3840 beats per minute
Sets the sequencer back to the first step
Switches on the step the sequencer is playing, so a pattern can be tapped in while it runs
Switches off the step the sequencer is playing
Sets how many of the sixteen steps are played before the pattern repeats, 1 to 16
Switches its step on or off; the button is lit while that step is on

inputs.text: The voltage here is added to the CLOCK knob, a volt doubling the tempo
With a cable here a rise steps the sequencer on and the internal clock is not used
A rise here sets the sequencer back to the first step
A voltage above 0V here switches on the step the sequencer is playing
A voltage above 0V here switches off the step the sequencer is playing
The voltage here is added to the STEPS knob, a volt for each step
A rise here switches that step on or off

outputs.text: A 1ms 10V pulse on each step that is switched on
